name: Baba Yaga

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Fey Trap
traits.details: Enemies in the aura cannot willingly teleport, and they take a -2 penalty to saving throws. Flying enemies in the aura cannot hover, and the aura is difficult terrain for them.

traits.name: Slippery Mind
traits.details: Any dazing, dominating, or stunning effect on Baba Yaga ends at the start of her turn.

powers.name: Vile Transmutation
powers.usageDetails: when Baba Yaga spends an action point

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target transforms into a Tiny toad or Small pig (save ends). Its equipment becomes part of its new form and cannot be used. While in the form, the target cannot attack and has vulnerable 10 to all damage. The effect ends if the target takes damage.

miss.description: Half damage, and the target grants combat advantage until the end of Baba Yaga’s next turn.

effect.description: Baba Yaga teleports up to 5 squares and uses broomstick.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature Baba Yaga can see

hit.description: Baba Yaga slides the target up to 5 squares, and the target makes a basic attack as a free action against a creature of Baba Yaga’s choice. The target can refuse to make the attack. If the target does so or its basic attack misses, it takes 3d10 + 20 psychic damage and falls prone.

effect.description: Baba gains 25 temporary hit points. If the fire damage reduces Baba Yaga to 0 hit points, she does not die and is instead removed from play until the start of her next turn, and all effects on her end. When she returns, she appears in an unoccupied space within 10 squares of her original space, and she has 50 hit points.

powers.name: Witch’s Curse
powers.trigger: An enemy within 10 squares of Baba Yaga deals damage to her.

hit.description: necrotic and psychic damage, and the target falls prone.
